question: Spot the spelling error.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The spelling error is in the word **"Archaetype" (Option 1)**.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"Archetype".**
 
• An archetype refers to a typical example of a person, thing, or concept.
 
• The other options "Misanthrope," "Quintessential," and "Resurgence" are spelled correctly and do not contain errors.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Spelling:** *"Archetype"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Misanthrope:** Refers to a person who dislikes humankind and avoids human society.
 
• **Quintessential:** Describes something as the most perfect or typical example of a quality or class.
 
• **Resurgence:** Means an increase or revival after a period of little activity, popularity, or occurrence.
